title: Tony Fish reads Revolut's board purge against financial gravity — 'We keep moving the furniture around inside the same building and calling it reform'
summary: Revolut's co-founder told Sifted he had removed every VC from the board and advised founders to take the money but give investors no seat. Fish, who teaches at Henley and the LSE, credits Eric with the term financial gravity and argues that removing the investors does not remove the pull, only the source of it.
blockquote: We keep moving the furniture around inside the same building and calling it reform. Taking VCs off the board doesn’t remove "financial gravity" it just changes whose orbit you’re in.
attribution_title: Author, My Digital Footprint · Visiting Fellow, Henley Business School
